messages:
olivia (release-manager): Heads-up: we need to stagger the landing of PRs that touch the deployment config for eu-west due to the planned network maintenance on Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. Can teams who have pending merges for that region hold off until we coordinate a canary?

sam (platform): Ack. Which PRs specifically? I have #14622 (autoscaler tweaks) and #14687 (kv cache refactor).

olivia (release-manager): Thanks. Those two are the main ones. Also @lee mentioned #14599 (session routing) earlier. We should aim to land a single canary first, wait 30m, then stagger the rest.

lee (qa): FYI #14599 has been flaky in integration on eu-west CI, failure is `TestSessionAffinity` 3/10 runs. Repro steps are flaky locally too. I can run a focused job if we want to canary it.

sam (platform): Hmm. I can flip the feature-flag for routing in the canary to limit blast radius. For autoscaler and kv changes we can land them to a single node pool. Plan: land #14622 as canary -> wait 30m -> land #14687 -> then #14599 after we confirm QA. Sound good? :thumbsup:

olivia (release-manager): Sounds safe. Two asks: (1) rebase PRs onto latest main before the window, (2) get at least one approval from infra or runtime for those. Can we have both by EOD today?

sam (platform): I'll rebase #14622 and #14687 now, pinging @tess for review. I'll also add a canary rollout policy in the PR description: `canary: 1-nodepool, region=eu-west, 30m wait`.

tess (infra): On review. Quick note: don't forget to update the autoscaler annotation for the canary group or the autoscaler will autoscale everything. Small patch incoming.

lee (qa): I'll run a dedicated eu-west integration job for #14599 and attach logs. If flakiness continues, we should hold it until after the maintenance window to avoid masking infra issues.

release-bot: Reminder: Deploy freeze starts Tue 02:30 UTC for emergency window. See #infra-notices.

olivia (release-manager): Good catch @release-bot. Freeze window overlaps the maintenance; that's why we need to sequence carefully. Plan B if CI fails: abort canary and rollback feature-flag, leave PRs open for next slot.

sam (platform): Will tag @tess and @lee on each PR with the canary coordinates and rebase notes. ETA rebases + reviewers: 4h.

olivia (release-manager): Perfect. I'll reserve the 03:00-04:00 UTC slot as the landing window for the canary, and 04:30-05:00 UTC for follow-ups if everything looks green. If any one of you sees a blocker, DM me and we'll push.

lee (qa): I'll post the integration job link here when done.

sam (platform): quick command I'm going to run for the canary rollout (for the record):
```
kubectl label nodepool eu-west-canary canary=true --overwrite
# then patch deployment with nodeSelector: nodepool=eu-west-canary
```

olivia (release-manager): Thanks. Minimal comms for the window: a single thread in #eng-releases and pings to oncall if rollback required. :white_check_mark:

tess (infra): Reviewing now, will leave a single inline comment.

lee (qa): Integration job queued: https://ci.internal/jobs/84723 — will upload logs in 15m.

sam (platform): thanks all. I'll update PR titles to include `[canary-eu-west]` so release tooling picks them up.

olivia (release-manager): Great coordination. I'll post a short postmortem template in this thread after the window so we can capture any learnings. :rocket:
